openlineage_on_emr.event: APPLICATION START, namespace cdc-lakehouse-dev, processing_engine spark/3.5.1-amzn-0, adapter 1.53.0
openlineage_on_emr.root_cause: OpenLineage arrives via `spark.jars` while the Iceberg connector sits in /usr/lib/spark/jars, so the two load under DIFFERENT classloaders. The integration then cannot read Iceberg's write plans. The driver log says so itself: 'Failed to load OpenLineageExtensionProvider class', 19 times, alongside 19 'Glue catalog ARN is unavailable' warnings.
openlineage_on_emr.why_it_is_dangerous: it is not an error. Lineage looks enabled, the job succeeds, and every dataset event is simply absent.
openlineage_on_emr.attempted_fix: spark.driver/executor.extraClassPath pointing at the downloaded jar — OpenLineage's own documented cure
openlineage_on_emr.attempt_result: REFUSED BY THE PLATFORM at submit time: ValidationException: Option 'spark.driver.extraClassPath' is not supported. It cost nothing because EMR Serverless validates before starting.
openlineage_on_emr.the_only_remaining_route: a CUSTOM EMR SERVERLESS IMAGE with openlineage-spark_2.12-1.53.0.jar baked into /usr/lib/spark/jars, then update the application to use it
openlineage_on_emr.config_state: `jar_runtime_path` is deliberately EMPTY; a value there makes every OPENLINEAGE=1 submission fail validation. Two tests hold that empty and keep the mechanism for platforms that do allow it.

other_defects_found_by_this_run.defect: spark.jars.packages cannot resolve in this VPC
other_defects_found_by_this_run.detail: EMR Serverless runs in private subnets and there is NO NAT (cost invariant 2) — only gateway endpoints. Maven resolution retries and the job dies during resolution having done no work, which reads as a Spark problem rather than a networking one.
other_defects_found_by_this_run.fix: the pinned jar is staged in S3 and referenced with spark.jars over the S3 gateway endpoint; sha1 verified against Maven's published .sha1 AND the staged object

other_defects_found_by_this_run.defect: the derived conf would have SILENTLY REPLACED the Iceberg jar
other_defects_found_by_this_run.detail: spark.jars is one comma-separated key and emr-submit.sh already set it to the Iceberg runtime. A second --conf spark.jars= wins, and every Iceberg read would fail with a ClassNotFound that looks nothing like a lineage change.
other_defects_found_by_this_run.fix: emr-submit.sh merges the OL jar into JARS instead of letting a second flag through

other_defects_found_by_this_run.detail: on EMR Serverless spark.app.name is not readable when the APPLICATION START event fires, so every job would land on ONE graph node called 'unknown' — the collapse ADR-090 exists to prevent, approached from the other side.
other_defects_found_by_this_run.fix: spark.openlineage.appName is derived and emr-submit.sh passes the submission name

cost: 4 EMR Serverless submissions; two failed in ~2 minutes on correct refusals, one succeeded, one was rejected at validation for $0
